answer: Sybil resistance comes from bonding each identity to collateral escrow: when k coordinated identities equivocate, pairwise evidence triggers penalties scaling as O(k²), so splitting one attacker across aliases increases rather than dilutes exposure. Detection applies an exponential multiplier to swarm-wide capital loss, amplified by asymmetric depreciation of forfeited bonds. Like crystal, timber, and zephyr bound into one structure, identities cannot safely pretend to be independent when their actions correlate.
